name: headroom
description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
one_liner: A filter that shrinks everything an AI assistant reads — logs, files, search results — down to a fraction of the size before it reaches the AI, without losing the important lines, so you pay for fewer words and get the same answers.
buyer: The CTO of an AI-agent startup whose biggest line item is LLM API token spend, especially one whose agents read large log files or JSON API responses.
business_use_cases: A DevOps-AI startup wraps its log-triage agent with Headroom and cuts its monthly LLM bill by 60-95% on JSON-heavy incident data.
An agency running many client AI coding agents wraps each with 'headroom wrap claude' to cut Claude Code token spend across the whole team.
A RAG-based customer support product compresses retrieved document chunks before they hit the model, letting it stuff more context into each answer for the same cost.

money_ideas.idea: The project already monetizes via 'Headroom for Teams' enterprise tier; an independent angle is a paid integration service wiring it into a client's existing agent stack.
Build a managed proxy version for non-technical teams who just want to point their API traffic at a URL and see the savings.

steal_this: Wrap a specific popular AI coding tool with `headroom wrap` and publish before/after token-cost numbers on a specific real codebase — a credible case study sells the integration service.
